cnTitle: 四化优先级：先找风险、再看机会、最后评助力
enTitle: The Priority Order of the Four Transformations
enDesc: When reading a chart the transformations have priority: Hua Ji first, then Lu, then Quan, then Ke. First find Ji for risk and sticking points, then Lu for opportunity and resources, finally Quan Ke for control and reputation. With the right order, effort goes where it matters.
cnDesc: 读盘时四化有优先级：化忌＞化禄＞化权＞化科，先找化忌定风险卡点、再看化禄定机会资源、最后用权科评掌控与名声；顺序对了，精力花在刀刃上。

cnTitle: 桃花应期怎么看：不是只找桃花星，要看飞化引动
enTitle: How to Read the Timing of Romance
enDesc: To see when romance arrives, do not only check whether the year has Hong Luan or Tian Xi; read whether the Children Palace (romance palace) flights activate romance stars or romance-bearing main stars. When activation forms groups with strong force, the chance of a bond is high.
cnDesc: 看桃花什么时候来，不能只看流年有没有红鸾天喜，要看子女宫（桃花宫）的飞化有没有引动桃花星或带桃花的主星，引动成组、力量足，情缘概率才高。

cnTitle: 叠宫叠盘怎么看：本命大限流年叠得越多，主题越重
enTitle: How to Read Stacked Palaces and Layered Charts
enDesc: Read the same palace stacked across natal, decade and year: when an area is activated on all three layers, the stage theme concentrates there. Stacked palaces read the accumulation of force, not simple repetition.
cnDesc: 本命、大限流年的同一宫位叠在一起看：某领域在三层都被引动，这阶段主题就集中在那；叠宫读的是力量的叠加，不是简单重复。

cnTitle: 六十星系怎么看：按花甲分系，判断星性变化的骨架
enTitle: How to Read the Sixty Star Systems
enDesc: The sixty star systems divide star combinations by the sixty Jia Zi; the same major star expresses differently across systems. It is the framework for judging how star nature changes with palace and companions; read combinations by first recognizing the system.
cnDesc: 六十星系把星曜组合按六十花甲分系，同一颗主星在不同星系里表达方式会变；它是判断星性随宫位和同伴变化的骨架，读组合先认清属于哪一系。

cnTitle: 对星怎么看：有些星要一对对读，单看一颗读不全
enTitle: How to Read Paired Stars
enDesc: Some stars appear in pairs and define each other: Fu-Xiang, Chang-Qu, Kui-Yue, Zuo-You, Yang-Tuo, Huo-Ling, Kong-Jie. See Fu with Xiang and Chang with Qu; splitting them loses half the meaning.
cnDesc: 斗数里有些星成对出现、互相定义：府相、昌曲、魁钺、左右、羊陀、火铃、空劫；逢府看相、逢昌看曲，拆成单颗就丢了一半含义。

cnTitle: 一事一占：专门追一件事，不泛泛看全盘
enTitle: One Matter, One Reading: Focused Divination
enDesc: One matter one reading locks onto one concrete thing (job, money, lawsuit, romance), sets Tai Ji for it, flies transformations and reads landings to give that one matter tendency; it does not judge every area of the chart.
cnDesc: 一事一占是锁定一件具体事（求职、求财、官司、姻缘），为它立太极、飞四化、看落点，给出这一件事的倾向；不把整张盘每个领域都断一遍。

cnTitle: 看盘怎么提验：把推断写下来，事后对照应验
enTitle: How to Verify Your Chart Readings
enDesc: Verification is the practical way to improve: write down predictions beforehand (which stage, what matter, what tendency), then compare afterward; record matches and find reasons for misses, and skill grows fast.
cnDesc: 提验是提升读盘的实办法：事前把推断（哪个阶段、哪件事、什么倾向）写下来，事后逐条对照，应验的记对、没应验的找原因，水平才长得快。

cnTitle: 星盘综合总结：宫星化限四层读完，给不矛盾的结论
enTitle: How to Synthesize the Whole Chart
enDesc: Synthesis reads palaces, stars, transformations and decade, integrating them into one consistent conclusion: what the main axis is, where the current stage sits, where risks and opportunities are, not scattered statements.
cnDesc: 综合总结是把宫位、星曜、四化、大限四层读完，整合成一个前后不矛盾的整体结论：主轴是什么、当前阶段在哪、风险机会各在哪，不东一句西一句。

cnTitle: 四化组成路线：资源—掌控—名声—课题连成一条线
enTitle: The Route Formed by the Four Transformations
enDesc: Lu Quan Ke Ji each govern a segment, together forming one complete route: Lu gives resources to start, Quan gives control to execute, Ke gives reputation to finish and Ji gives the lesson to work on. They are not four isolated buttons but one energy-flow line.
cnDesc: 禄权科忌各管一段，连起来是一条完整路线：化禄给资源起步、化权给掌控执行、化科给名声收尾、化忌给要修的课题；四化不是四颗孤立按钮，是一条能量流动线。

cnTitle: 飞禄飞忌：一宫干飞禄看投入、飞忌看结果
enTitle: Flying Lu and Flying Ji from a Palace Stem
enDesc: For a palace, its stem flying Lu shows active investment and opportunity in the area, flying Ji shows attachment and result. The flying Lu and Ji together read why it invests and what result finally lands.
cnDesc: 看某宫，宫干飞化禄看这领域主动投入与机缘，飞化忌看它的牵挂与结果；一宫之飞禄飞忌合起来，才读得到这件事「因什么投入、最后落什么结果」。

cnTitle: 四化引合：飞化碰生年自化「成组」，力量翻倍
enTitle: Transformations Joining: When Flights Meet Natal or Self-Transformations
enDesc: Joining is when flights meet natal or self-transformations and form groups, reinforcing force: Lu with Ji is one group, Quan with Ke another. See whether a matter is joined and forms groups to judge whether force doubles or falls through.
cnDesc: 引合是飞化碰到生年四化或自化、「成组」时力量加强：禄与忌成一组、权与科成一组；看一件事有没有被引合、成不成组，判断这股力量是翻倍还是落空。

cnTitle: 权科路线：实干被看见，专业成名的一条路
enTitle: The Quan-Ke Route: Doing the Work and Being Seen
enDesc: Quan execution connects with Ke reputation, the route of doing, being seen and becoming known: first use Quan to do solid work, then Ke to have expertise recognized, suiting technical, professional and scholarly standing; guard competitiveness and empty name.
cnDesc: 化权的执行接化科的名声，是「实干—被看见—成名」的路线：先靠权把事做扎实，再靠科让专业被认可，适合技术、专业、学术立身，防好胜和虚名。

cnTitle: 怎么对批盘：拿自己和他人盘对照练，入门快法
enTitle: How to Practice by Comparing Charts
enDesc: Comparing charts is a fast beginner method: take your own chart and those of familiar family or friends, see how the same palace differs across star natures, then compare with real temperament, and star nature and placement are understood quickly.
cnDesc: 对批盘是入门快法：拿自己的盘和熟悉的家人朋友盘对照，看同一类宫位在不同星性下的差别，再对照现实性格，星性和落宫就理解得快。

cnTitle: 怎么学星曜：先认星性阴阳五行，再看落宫
enTitle: How to Learn the Stars: Nature, Yin-Yang and Elements First
enDesc: When learning stars, do not rush to memorize palace fortune; first learn each star yin-yang, elements and core meaning, then see how it changes across palaces and companions. Star nature is the root, placement the branches.
cnDesc: 学星曜别急着背落宫吉凶，先认每颗星的阴阳、五行与核心象义，再看它落在不同宫位、遇到不同同伴怎么变；星性是根，落宫是枝叶。

cnTitle: 怎么看财富层次：财帛官禄田宅三宫合看
enTitle: How to Read Wealth Levels: Three Palaces Together
enDesc: Wealth levels cannot rest on Wealth alone; read three palaces: Wealth writes how you earn, Career (trine) writes income sources, Property writes whether it settles into a treasury. All three steady means a high wealth level; only one palace strong is often passing money.
cnDesc: 财富层次不能只看财帛，要三宫合看：财帛写赚钱方式、官禄（三方）写收入来源、田宅写能不能沉淀成库；三宫都稳，财富层次才高，只旺一宫多是过路钱。

cnTitle: 怎么看健康：疾厄宫与三方四化，看倾向不是诊断
enTitle: How to Read Health: The Health Palace and Tendencies
enDesc: Health reads the Health Palace star, trines and transformations for where the body tends to be vulnerable and which stages are thresholds. It is not a medical diagnosis; any discomfort must be checked at a proper hospital, not delayed for astrology.
cnDesc: 健康看疾厄宫主星与三方、四化，看的是身体容易在哪些方面有倾向、哪些阶段是关口；它不是医学诊断，任何不适都要以正规医院检查为准，不因命理拖延就医。

cnTitle: 双禄朝垣格：禄存化禄三方会照，财气稳
enTitle: The Two Lu Facing the Origin Pattern
enDesc: When Lu Cun and Hua Lu meet the Life Palace in the triple-direction, it brings thick wealth and steady income, either rank or riches. But it still needs Zuo You and officials around for distinction; without auspicious support it is often rich without rank, and malefics break it.
cnDesc: 禄存与化禄在三方四正加会命宫，主财气厚、收入稳，不大贵即大富；但仍要左右百官拱照才贵，无吉星扶持多是富而不贵，逢煞冲破也破格。

cnTitle: 甲第登科格：昌曲魁钺化科会命，利功名考试
enTitle: The Top Graduate Pattern: Chang Qu, Kui Yue and Hua Ke
enDesc: When Wen Chang Wen Qu, Tian Kui Tian Yue and Hua Ke gather at the Life Palace, like a top graduate in the imperial exam, it brings intelligence, good exam fortune and smooth distinction, favoring scholarship, public service and education. Malefics break it and discount exam fortune.
cnDesc: 文昌文曲、天魁天钺与化科会聚命宫，如科举甲第登科，主聪明、考试运佳、功名顺遂，利学术、公职、文教；逢煞忌破格，考运打折。

cnTitle: 文桂文华格：昌曲遇吉星，文才出众利学术
enTitle: The Literary Laurel and Splendor Pattern
enDesc: When Wen Chang Wen Qu meet auspicious stars and Hua Ke, like a laurel blooming, it brings literary talent, learning and artistic sensitivity, favoring scholarship, writing and education. Guard letters without substance and talk without practice; malefics break it.
cnDesc: 文昌文曲遇吉星、化科会聚，如桂树开花，主文才、学问、艺术感受力，利学术研究、写作、文教；要防有文无实、光说不练，逢煞破格。

cnTitle: 巨机同宫格：巨门天机同度，善辩善谋利思辨
enTitle: The Ju Men and Tian Ji Same-Palace Pattern
enDesc: When Ju Men (speech and critical thought) and Tian Ji (strategy and change) share the Life Palace, it brings eloquence, planning and quick response, favoring planning, debate, research and expression. Guard mental toil, overthinking and disputes; auspicious transformations use the talent well.
cnDesc: 巨门（口舌思辨）与天机（谋略变动）同宫守命，主善辩、善谋、反应快，利策划、辩论、研究、表达；防心劳、多思、口舌招非，逢吉化才把才思用好。

cnTitle: 昌曲夹命：文昌文曲在左右，文气贴身
enTitle: Chang Qu Flanking the Life Palace
enDesc: When Wen Chang and Wen Qu guard the two flanking palaces around Life, it brings close literary force, strong expression and favors exams and documents. As a paired-star flank, auspicious transformations brighten literary name; malefics discount talent.
cnDesc: 文昌文曲分守命宫左右夹宫，主文气贴身、表达力强、利考试文书；同对星夹命，逢吉化文名更显，逢煞冲破则文采打折。

cnTitle: 七杀朝斗格：七杀寅申守命、对宫紫微，威权立功名
enTitle: Qi Sha Facing the Pole Pattern
enDesc: When Qi Sha guards life at Yin or Shen with Zi Wei opposite, like Qi Sha facing the North Pole, it brings authority, decisiveness and martial distinction, favoring police-military, pioneering and management. Guard isolation and injury; auspicious stars must temper it.
cnDesc: 七杀在寅、申守命、对宫紫微，如七杀朝见北斗，主威权、决断、武职功名，利军警、开拓、管理；防孤克、刑伤，须吉星调和。

cnTitle: 将星得地格：武曲庙旺守命，刚毅财星得用
enTitle: The General Star Well-Placed Pattern: Wu Qu at Brightness
enDesc: When Wu Qu (general and wealth star) guards life at a bright palace, it brings resolve, decisiveness, finance and execution, favoring finance, police-military, engineering and technology. Guard excess rigidity and bluntness; auspicious stars temper it to use the general-wealth star well.
cnDesc: 武曲（将星、财星）在庙旺宫位守命，主刚毅、果断、理财与执行，利金融、军警、工程、技术；防过刚、孤直，逢吉星调和才把财星将星用好。

cnTitle: 紫微星总论：帝星主尊贵、领导，百官拱才成格
enTitle: The Zi Wei Star Overview: The Emperor Star
enDesc: Zi Wei is the North Pole ruler and emperor star, governing distinction, leadership, face and high standards. Zi Wei alone needs the hundred officials (Zuo You Kui Yue Chang Qu Fu Xiang) around to form a great pattern; without assistants it is aloof, and malefics make it proud and toilsome.
cnDesc: 紫微星为北斗主、帝星，主尊贵、领导、好面子与高标准；紫微独坐要百官（左右魁钺昌曲府相）拱照才成大格，无辅则孤高，逢煞破则高傲劳碌。

cnTitle: 文昌星总论：主文书、考试、理性、契约
enTitle: The Wen Chang Star Overview: Documents, Exams and Reason
enDesc: Wen Chang governs documents, exams, reason and contracts, the star of scholarly distinction. With Hua Ke its literary name shows and favors exams and signing; fallen or with malefics, guard document errors and contract disputes. It gives order and writing, not ready distinction.
cnDesc: 文昌星主文书、考试、理性与契约，是科甲主星；逢化科文名显、利考试签约，落陷或逢煞防文书出错、契约纠纷，文昌给的是条理和文墨，不是现成功名。

cnTitle: 文曲星总论：主口才、艺术、感性、异路功名
enTitle: The Wen Qu Star Overview: Speech, Art and Feeling
enDesc: Wen Qu governs speech, art, feeling and distinction by an unconventional path, opposite Wen Chang (reason). With auspicious transformations it favors communication, art and verbal fame; with malefics, guard disputes, moodiness and relationship entanglement. It gives expression and sensitivity.
cnDesc: 文曲星主口才、艺术、感性与异路功名，与文昌（理性）相对；逢吉化利传播、艺术、口才成名，逢煞防口舌、情绪化、感情纠葛，文曲给的是表达和感受力。

cnTitle: 流年交接怎么看：旧年与新年气怎么转、主题怎么换
enTitle: How to Read the Transition Between Years
enDesc: The year transition reads how old and new year transformations and palaces switch: the old theme concludes, the new begins; around the boundary matters pile and minds unsettle; see where the energy turns for an orderly transition.
cnDesc: 流年交接看旧年与新年的四化和宫位怎么切换：旧年的主题收尾、新年的主题启动，交界前后往往事多、心不定，看清气往哪转，交接才不乱。

cnTitle: 月运怎么看：流年盘按月重布，看一月节奏
enTitle: How to Read Monthly Fortune
enDesc: Monthly fortune rebuilds the twelve palaces by month on the annual chart with month stems, reading a month rhythm and adjustments. It governs only small matters within the month; big matters still rely on year and decade, not to be over-read.
cnDesc: 月运在流年盘上按月重布十二宫、配月干支，看一个月的节奏与加减；它只主月内小事，大事仍看流年大限，不宜过度解读。

cnTitle: 日运怎么看：更细一层，参考价值有限不宜执着
enTitle: How to Read Daily Fortune: Limited Reference
enDesc: Daily fortune is a layer finer than monthly, reading daily fluctuations by day stems. Zi Wei shichen itself uses two-hour units; daily fortune is too fine-grained with limited reference, not to be fixated on or used to decide big matters.
cnDesc: 日运是比月运更细的一层，按日干支看每日起伏；斗数时辰本以两小时为单位，日运颗粒度过细、参考价值有限，不宜执着、更不该因日运决定大事。

cnTitle: 命盘可以改吗：盘改不了，但选择和行动改兑现
enTitle: Can a Chart Be Changed? The Chart Cannot, Choices Can
enDesc: The chart structure cannot change, but it writes tendencies not verdicts; environment, effort and key choices can change how and how much materializes. What cannot change is the tone, what is held is how to live.
cnDesc: 命盘排出来的结构改不了，但它写的是倾向不是定局；环境、努力、关键选择能改变兑现的程度和方向，改不了的是底色，握得住的是怎么活。

cnTitle: 学紫微需要基础吗：不必先会八字，干支补一补即可
enTitle: Do You Need Prior Foundation to Learn Zi Wei?
enDesc: Learning Zi Wei does not require knowing Ba Zi or other arts first; complete beginners can enter. Just supplement a little stems-branches and yin-yang elements, then learn in palace-star-transformation-limit order; the threshold is lower than imagined.
cnDesc: 学紫微不必先会八字或别的术数，零基础也能入门；只需先补一点天干地支、阴阳五行常识，再按宫星化限顺序学，门槛没有想象的高。

cnTitle: 命理可以全信吗：不可全信，参考倾向、自己做主
enTitle: Can Fortune Telling Be Fully Believed? Reference, Not Full Belief
enDesc: Fortortune telling can be neither fully believed nor wholly disbelieved; it gives tendencies and a reference framework, decisions and actions are yours. Full belief loses initiative, full disbelief removes a mirror for yourself.
cnDesc: 命理不可全信，也不必全不信；它给的是倾向和参考框架，决定和行动在自己，全信会失去主动权，全不信又少了一面照自己的镜子。

cnTitle: 考研进修怎么看：官禄文昌化科看节奏，努力是主体
enTitle: How to Read Graduate School and Further Study
enDesc: Graduate study reads the Career Palace, Wen Chang Wen Qu and whether the decade has Ke activation; stages favoring further study run smoother. But the chart only gives timing and state; review, method and persistence are the substance; seize smooth timing, work harder when not.
cnDesc: 考研进修看官禄宫、文昌文曲与大限有没有化科引动，利深造的阶段节奏更顺；但盘只给节奏和状态，复习、方法、坚持才是主体，节奏顺要抓紧、不顺要更努力。

cnTitle: 移民留学怎么看：迁移宫驿马化禄看远方缘分
enTitle: How to Read Immigration and Studying Abroad
enDesc: Immigration and study abroad read the Travel Palace, Tian Ma and Lu for distant-land bonds and timing. But procedures, visas and qualifications must take proper channels, following official requirements and written materials; the chart only hints at the distant theme, not guaranteeing results.
cnDesc: 移民留学看迁移宫、天马与化禄，看远方、外出的缘分和节奏；但手续、签证、资质必须走正规途径、以官方要求和书面材料为准，盘只提示远方主题，不替结果担保。

cnTitle: 合伙结义怎么看：交友宫看伙伴，权责写清再谈情
enTitle: How to Read Partnership and Sworn Alliance
enDesc: Partnership and sworn alliance read the Friends and Career Palaces for partner types and division. The closer the friends, the more authority, shares and exit terms must be written into a contract before feelings; rely on professional lawyers and proper channels, not verbal loyalty.
cnDesc: 合伙结义看交友宫与官禄，看伙伴类型和分工；越是好朋友越要先把权责、分成、退出写进书面合同，再谈情分，以专业律师和正规途径为准，不凭口头义气。

cnTitle: 理财保险怎么看：财帛田宅看节奏，产品合同持牌为准
enTitle: How to Read Financial Planning and Insurance
enDesc: Financial planning and insurance read Wealth, Property and decade timing for which stage suits conservative allocation or protection. But product choice must follow licensed institutions, formal contracts and product terms; this is not investment advice, and do not superstition high-return insurance products.
cnDesc: 理财保险看财帛、田宅与大限节奏，看哪个阶段适合稳健配置或保障安排；但产品选择必须以持牌机构、正式合同和产品说明为准，不构成投资建议，不迷信「理财型保险高收益」。

cnTitle: 健康关口怎么看：疾厄宫看时间倾向，非诊断
enTitle: How to Read Health Thresholds: Timing Tendencies, Not Diagnosis
enDesc: Health thresholds read the Health Palace and decade-year transformations for which stages need more body attention. It gives timing and direction tendencies, not diagnosis; around thresholds keep regular routines and seek timely care, deferring to proper hospitals.
cnDesc: 健康关口看疾厄宫与大限流年四化，看哪些阶段身体多操心、需要多留意；它给的是时间和方向倾向，不是诊断，关口前后更要规律作息、及时就医，以正规医院为准。

cnTitle: 体检怎么安排：结合健康节奏定期查，不因命理拖延
enTitle: How to Arrange Health Check-Ups
enDesc: Check-up scheduling can combine Health Palace timing, with more regular and targeted checks in tendency-prone stages. But all check-ups must be at proper medical institutions and follow doctors; the chart only hints timing, never delaying checks because astrology says fine.
cnDesc: 体检安排可结合疾厄宫的健康节奏，在容易有倾向的阶段更要定期、针对性检查；但任何体检都要到正规医疗机构、遵医嘱，盘只提示节奏，绝不能因「命理说没事」就拖延检查。

cnTitle: 领导相处怎么看：官禄父母宫看上下级，守专业懂边界
enTitle: How to Read Getting Along with Leaders
enDesc: Getting along with leaders reads the Career and Parents Palaces (elders and superiors) for superior bonds and communication. The long term relies on professional ability, reliability and boundaries, not flattery, and superior relations need not become opposition.
cnDesc: 与领导相处看官禄宫与父母宫（长辈上级），看上下级缘分和沟通方式；长期靠的是专业能力、靠谱和边界感，不靠一味讨好，也不必把上下级处成对立。

cnTitle: 店铺生意怎么看：财帛官禄田宅看经营，资质合同正规
enTitle: How to Read Shop and Store Business
enDesc: Shop business reads Wealth (income), Career (operation) and Property (premises) together with timing. But location, licenses, contracts and qualifications must take proper channels; the chart only hints at business timing, not investment advice or guaranteed profit.
cnDesc: 开店做生意看财帛（进账）、官禄（经营）、田宅（店面）三宫配合与节奏；但选址、执照、合同、资质必须走正规途径，盘只提示经营节奏，不构成投资建议，不保证稳赚。
